title: Capstone: Containerize a Real App
summary: Bring the whole track together: containerize shipit (TypeScript API, nginx-served web frontend, Postgres, Redis) to production standard with multi-stage multi-arch images, non-root hardening, healthchecks, dev and prod-like Compose files, migrations, GHCR publishing, scanning and a README.
objectives: Design the container architecture of a full-stack app: images, networks, volumes, secrets and startup order
Write production multi-stage Dockerfiles for a TypeScript API and an nginx static frontend, built for arm64 and amd64
Run the stack in development with hot reload and in a hardened prod-like configuration from the same base
Run database migrations safely as a one-off job
Publish images to GitHub Container Registry with SBOM and provenance, scan them, and measure their size
Document the project so another engineer can run, debug and operate it
